FN-A5TBQQS-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 127
Committee: Boards, Agencies, and Sponsor: Representative Margie Wilcox
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 127 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Board of Hearing Instrument
Dealers until October 1, 2029 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise
affect state or local funding.
